issues.quote: Total assets stood at $65.7 million at the end of fiscal 2024
issues.problem: The unit is wrong. NVIDIA's total assets at the end of fiscal 2024 (January 28, 2024) were about $65.7 billion, not million. The passage's own closing note says to record it as $65.7 billion, which contradicts the sentence as written.

data.summary: The analysis is mostly accurate, with one unit error. These figures match NVIDIA's reported fiscal 2024 results: revenue of $60.9B (up about 126% from $27.0B), net income of $29.8B, operating income of $33.0B, and cash and cash equivalents of $7.3B. Total assets are misstated as $65.7 million. The correct figure is $65.7 billion.
